title: Policy-specific minimum collateral
implementation_summary: added ComputeStakeCollateralPolicy420 as the canonical CMP-1.5 minimum-collateral policy authority
added append-only versioned worker/verifier collateral minima with exact policy commitments
separated mutable new-acceptance gating from immutable historical policy revisions
added independent worker/verifier active/slashable threshold evaluation with optional exit rejection
preserved custody/source-selection separation; the policy contract is non-custodial and source-neutral

required roles use nonzero minima and slashable minimum cannot exceed active minimum
worker and verifier requirements/minima are independently evaluated
historical revisions and commitments remain immutable after supersession or acceptance suspension
exact current revision/commitment is required for new acceptance
worker position evaluation enforces identity/revision, active state, active/slashable minima and optional exit rejection
verifier position evaluation additionally requires verifier authority and verifier revision
policy authority never custodies collateral or chooses a stake source
